description: Creates a commit with the given message (or, with noEdit/reuseMessage/fixup, the message git takes from there; message is then rejected). Returns structured data with hash, message, and change statistics. Pass `path` to target a specific repo or worktree — when omitted, operates on the server's own working directory, not the caller's (see #876).

cleanup.description: Control message whitespace handling (--cleanup), e.g. strip, whitespace, verbatim, scissors, default

message.description: Commit message. Required unless noEdit, reuseMessage or fixup supplies the message; rejected together with them.

noEdit.description: Keep the existing message (--no-edit): with amend, the previous commit's message; otherwise a prepared message such as MERGE_MSG. Do not pass message with it.

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

resetAuthor.description: Reset author info on amended commits (--reset-author)

trailer.description: Trailer strings to append (--trailer), e.g. 'Signed-off-by: Name <email>'

name: commit
title: Git Commit
